title: i_x: C_d(B(Σ),𝒱)_x ≅ C_d(B(M),𝒲)_x
body_html:
Twisted chain complex isomorphism

Let $\mathscr{V} \in \Coeff_G(\BSigma, \Phi)$, $\mathscr{W} := \Res \mathscr{V} \in \Coeff_M^0(\mathcal{B}(M))$. Write $$\mathscr{V}_{\mathcal{F}, x} := (\kappa_x^* \otimes \mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F})_{K_{x,0+} \cap \hat K_\mathcal{F}}, \qquad \mathscr{W}_{\mathcal{F}, x} := (\mathscr{W}_\mathcal{F})_{M_{x, 0+} \cap \hat M_\mathcal{F}},$$ $$C_d(\BSigma, \mathscr{V})_x := (\kappa_x^* \otimes C_d(\BSigma, \mathscr{V}))_{K_{x,0+}}, \qquad C_d(\mathcal{B}(M), \mathscr{W})_x := (C_d(\mathcal{B}(M), \mathscr{W}))_{M_{x, 0+}}.$$

Lemma A. For each facet $\mathcal{F}$ in $\mathcal{B}(M)$, $c_x$ from [[node:depth_zero_reduction.R_xF_coeff]] induces an isomorphism $$i_{x, \mathcal{F}} : \mathscr{V}_{\mathcal{F}, x} \;\xrightarrow{\;\cong\;}\; \mathscr{W}_{\mathcal{F}, x}.$$
proof_html:
Compose $(\kappa_x^ \otimes \mathscr{V}\mathcal{F}){K_{x,0+} \cap \hat K_\mathcal{F}} \cong (\mathscr{W}_\mathcal{F} \otimes (\kappa_x^ \otimes \kappa_\mathcal{F}){K{x,0+} \cap K_{\mathcal{F}, 0+}}){M{x, 0+} \cap \hat M_\mathcal{F}} \xrightarrow{\id \otimes c_x^{-1}} (\mathscr{W}\mathcal{F}){M_{x, 0+} \cap \hat M_\mathcal{F}}$. The first map is iso because the natural quotient $(K_{x,0+} \cap \hat K_\mathcal{F}) / (K_{x,0+} \cap K_{\mathcal{F}, 0+}) \to \hat K_\mathcal{F} / K_{\mathcal{F}, 0+}$ has image generated by $K_{x,0+} \cap \hat M_\mathcal{F} = M_{x, 0+} \cap \hat M_\mathcal{F}$. The second is iso because of (E3). $\square$

Global isomorphism

By Frobenius reciprocity, $$C_d(\BSigma, \mathscr{V}) = \bigoplus_{[\mathcal{F}] \in K_{x,0+} \backslash \BSigma_d} \cInd_{K_{x,0+} \cap \hat K_\mathcal{F}}^{K_{x,0+}} \mathscr{V}_\mathcal{F}.$$

Combining with [[node:depth_zero_reduction.M_K_orbit_bijection]] and the lemma above:

Lemma B. There is a canonical isomorphism $$i_x : C_d(\BSigma, \mathscr{V})_x \;\xrightarrow{\;\cong\;}\; C_d(\mathcal{B}(M), \mathscr{W})_x.$$

Moreover, $i_x$ is compatible with boundary maps: $i_x \circ \partial_{\BSigma} = \partial_{\mathcal{B}(M)} \circ i_x$ (proved by a commutative-cube diagram chase). $\square$
